summary: Nvidia’s auto‑ontology library generates ontology files from structured data via a CLI and Python API. It builds on Python and runs locally without needing an API key. It is suited for developers building knowledge‑graph pipelines who want automated schema creation. The project’s strength is its active community (1,893 stars, recent commits) and unique auto‑generation feature, while its main caveat is poor test coverage (0 of 7 tests passed) and lack of a PyPI package.

github.description: Auto Ontology is a Python framework for building semantic, graph-based reasoning layers over data. It enables deterministic query generation, better context retrieval, and more explainable AI for LLM and agent workflows.
